answer.summary: Deterministic classpath mismatch, most likely from the Spring Boot 4 parent bump in pom.xml: Micrometer's DefaultMeterObservationHandler.builder(MeterRegistry) is missing at runtime (NoSuchMethodError), so the Spring context fails to start. Every other error here is a cascade from that one failure (438 errors, 74195). Retry will not help; align the Micrometer version with Spring Boot 4.

evidence.quote: Correct the classpath of your application so that it contains compatible versions of the classes org.springframework.boot.micrometer.metrics.autoconfigure.MetricsAutoConfiguration and io.micrometer.core.instrument.observation.DefaultMeterObservationHandler
